facts.statement: Pseudodalatias belongs to the monotypic family Pseudodalatiidae.
facts.quote: It is placed in the monotypic family Pseudodalatiidae

facts.statement: Scientists debate whether Pseudodalatias is a neoselachian or a hybodont.
facts.quote: It is disputed as to whether it represents a neoselachian, or a hybodont

facts.statement: This extinct cartilaginous fish lived in England, Italy, and Spain during the Triassic period.
facts.quote: Pseudodalatias is an extinct genus of cartilaginous fish which existed in England, Italy and Spain during the Triassic period

facts.statement: The genus Pseudodalatias was described by Reif in 1978.
Pseudodalatias lived between 241.464 and 199.5 million years ago, from the Ladinian to the Hettangian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Ladinian to Hettangian (241.464 to 199.5 million years ago)

facts.statement: The genus includes two species: Pseudodalatias barnstonensis and Pseudodalatias henarejensis.
facts.quote: subdivision: Pseudodalatias barnstonensis (Sykes, 1971) Pseudodalatias henarejensis Botella et al., 2009
